prefix: Photorealistic costume reference photograph of one person standing alone, full length from head to feet, front view, relaxed natural stance, empty hands, plain white studio background, soft even light. Hellenistic Greece, 3rd century BC, hand-woven wool and linen, a real face.
sandals: Simple flat leather sandals held on by thin thongs tied round the ankle.

mercenary.text: A hired soldier, a lean weathered man of about thirty, short dark hair and short dark beard, bare-headed. A knee-length {colour} wool tunic under a stiff white linen corslet with shoulder flaps tied down on the chest and a short skirt of hanging linen strips at the hips. A short {colour} wool cloak pinned at the right shoulder, bronze greaves. {sandals}

bandit.text: A hill bandit, a rough man of about thirty-five, dark hair and full dark beard, bare-headed. A knee-length {colour} wool tunic with a plain leather belt, a {colour} wool cloak draped over the left shoulder, bronze bracers on both forearms. {sandals}

arche-messenger.text: A young man messenger, bare-headed, short dark hair. A short undyed wool exomis, one rectangle of cloth belted at the waist, leaving his right shoulder and arm bare. A soft hide sack on a cord across his body.{extra} {sandals}

accountant.text: A middle-aged man, a trading house's accountant, short grey-flecked beard. A long undyed wool chiton pinned at both shoulders, with a brown wool himation wrapped round his body and draped over his left shoulder. {sandals}

clerk.text: A young clerk of a trading house, clean-shaven, short dark hair. A knee-length undyed linen chiton pinned at both shoulders and belted at the waist, bare arms, a reed pen tucked behind one ear. {sandals}

legislator-man.text: A white-bearded old man, a legislator. A long white linen chiton to the ankle, pinned at both shoulders with small bronze pins, a purple cord belt at the waist, a purple woven band at the hem. {sandals}

legislator-woman.text: A grey-haired woman, a legislator. A long white linen chiton to the ankle, pinned at both shoulders with small bronze pins, a purple cord belt at the waist, a purple woven band at the hem. {sandals}

priest.text: An old white-haired man, a priest, an olive wreath on his head. A long plain white linen chiton to the ankle, pinned at both shoulders with small bronze pins, a red cord belt. {sandals}

paxos-messenger.text: A young man messenger, bare-headed, curly dark hair. A short blue wool exomis, one rectangle of cloth belted at the waist, leaving his right shoulder and arm bare. A soft hide sack on a cord at his hip. {sandals}

merchant.text: A plump middle-aged man, a merchant, short beard. A short cream wool chiton to the knee, pinned at both shoulders, an ochre woven band at the hem, a cord belt, a small hide sack on a cord at his hip. {sandals}

goatherd.text: A wiry weathered goatherd of about forty, unkempt hair and beard. A rough brown wool exomis leaving his right shoulder bare, tied at the waist with a rope belt. Bare feet.

scholar.text: A lean thoughtful man of about fifty, a scholar, short grey beard. A short grey wool chiton to the knee, pinned at both shoulders, a cord belt. {sandals}

librarian.text: A woman of about forty-five, a librarian, dark hair pinned up. A long undyed cream wool chiton to the ankle, pinned at both shoulders, a cord belt. {sandals}

council.text: A {who}, a council member of a small Greek city. An ankle-length {colour} wool chiton, with a {colour} wool himation draped over the left shoulder and pinned. {sandals}

runner.text: A lean young man of about twenty, a runner, short dark hair, bare-headed. A short undyed brown wool tunic belted at the waist, bare arms and legs. {sandals}

priestess.text: An older woman, a priestess, calm and grey-haired. A long white wool peplos reaching the ankles, pinned at both shoulders and belted, bare forearms, a white veil over her hair. {sandals}

student-man.text: A young man of about eighteen, a student, short hair, bare-headed. A plain {colour} chiton to the knee, pinned at both shoulders and belted at the waist. {sandals}

student-woman.text: A young woman of about eighteen, a student, hair tied back, bare-headed. A plain {colour} chiton to the ankle, pinned at both shoulders and belted at the waist. {sandals}

characters.extra: A broad red sash worn across his chest from shoulder to hip.
